text: The headphones paired quickly and lasted about nine hours. The ear cushions become warm after long calls.
The grinder is louder than expected, but the medium setting produces consistent grounds for my filter coffee.
I used the backpack on two flights. The laptop sleeve fits well, although the side pocket is too narrow for my bottle.
Step tracking is close to my previous watch and notifications work reliably. Charging takes around ninety minutes.
Voice clarity is good at normal volume. Bass is limited, which is reasonable for a speaker this size.
The keys feel firm and the cable is long enough for my desk. The space bar has a slightly hollow sound.
The bottle did not leak in my bag and kept water cool through the afternoon. The lid needs two hands to open.
Assembly took ten minutes and the brightness control works as described. The base can slide on a smooth desk.
Food releases easily with a small amount of oil. The handle stays cool, but the pan is heavier than my old one.
It charges my phone and tablet at the same time. The supplied cable is short, so I replaced it with a longer one.
